description: Every example of the mostro-cli book. `file` is relative to this folder and holds exactly what the CLI writes to stdout (pretty-printed). `argv` is the invocation, assuming MOSTRO_PUBKEY and RELAYS are set in the environment. `command` is the envelope's command field (null when unresolved); `schema` overrides the output schema used to validate it. `source.kind`: fixture = a contract fixture of the mostro-cli test suite (refreshed by scripts/import_fixtures.py); captured = real output of the binary; authored = written for the book and validated against the schema.
